examples.description: Is the calling consumer authorised on this org?

description: Return the authorisation snapshot for the calling consumer's delegation on a Norwegian organisation: the `status` enum (`full` / `partial` / `none`), `missing_scopes` (empty on `full`), `granted_scopes`, and the `delegation_chain` breadcrumbs. To check whether a SPECIFIC action is permitted, compare `granted_scopes` to the scopes it requires. Always runs against the calling consumer — no per-action or per-actor input at v1. Always a 200: with no delegation the verdict is `status: "none"`, never a 404. Input: { org_number } (9 digits, MOD-11). Failure modes: VALIDATION_FAILED; a credential without `read:altinn` can't see the tool; a call returns unknown tool (-32602). For a SPECIFIC person's actions, use list_acting_capacity instead. Before a live execute, use validate_action to preflight the same delegation rule at zero upstream cost. For the per-agent-principal breakdown, use check_fullmakt; for statutory signing authority, use get_company_authority. No sandbox mirror. Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/fullmakt
description_nb: Hent autorisasjonsstatusen for konsumentens Altinn-delegering på et selskap: `status`, `missing_scopes`, `granted_scopes` og `delegation_chain`. Svarer alltid 200 — ingen delegering gir `status: none`. For en bestemt persons handlinger, bruk list_acting_capacity i stedet; for nedbrytingen per agent-principal, bruk check_fullmakt; for lovbestemt signaturrett, bruk get_company_authority. Krever read:altinn.

org_number.description: 9-digit Norwegian organisasjonsnummer (passing MOD-11) the calling consumer's delegation is checked against.

name: check_authorization

outputSchema.description: Rule 34 envelope; failures set result null + metadata.error_code / retryable / remediation. Contract: https://www.apier.no/docs/mcp

result.description: The authorisation snapshot for the calling consumer's delegation on the organisation: status enum, missing_scopes, granted_scopes, and the delegation_chain breadcrumbs.
